units.title: Chord lengths in the tangent and two circumcircle construction
units.statement: For A=(−a,0), B=(a,0), C=(u,v) in an acute triangle, let the tangents to the circumcircle at A and B meet at T, D=CT∩AB, E be the second intersection of TA with the circumcircle of CAD, and F the second intersection of TB with the circumcircle of CBD. If EF meets AC and BC at P and Q, then E,F,P,Q are horizontal, PQ=2a(u²+v²−a²)/(u²+v²+a²), and EF=PQ+AB.
steps: Compute the tangent intersection and D in coordinates
Find the second circle intersections E and F and observe they have equal height
Intersect the horizontal line with AC and BC and subtract their coordinates
